definitions.explanation: A formal indication of choice in an election or decision. Also used as a counter for votes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一票|いっぴょう}→一票：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じた→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧。
examples.english: I cast one vote in the election.
examples.notes: ⟦{一票|いっぴょう}→一票：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じる→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧ = to cast a vote

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧{票|ひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}した→当選する：07074_tousen⟧。
examples.english: She was elected with the most votes.

examples.japanese: {票|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The work of counting votes continues.

notes:
{票|ひょう} functions both as a noun meaning vote/ballot and as a counter for counting votes.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {票|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to vote, to cast a ballot
- {票|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じる→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧: to cast a vote (more formal)
- {票|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to gather votes
- {票|ひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧: to count votes

COUNTER READINGS:
Sound changes occur with numbers: {一票|いっぴょう} (1 vote), {二票|にひょう} (2), {三票|さんびょう}/{三票|さんぴょう} (3), {四票|よんひょう} (4), etc.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{得票|とくひょう}→得票：19111_tokuhyou⟧: votes obtained
- ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧: voting, casting a ballot
- ⟦{開票|かいひょう}→開票：19117_kaihyou⟧: vote counting (opening ballots)
- ⟦{白票|はくひょう}→白票：28194_hakuhyou⟧: blank ballot
